levels.name: Signal Relay

startScreen.title: Signal Relay
startScreen.subtitle: Restore three relay consoles in a silent communications station. Slip past patrol drones or use your sidearm, then reach the green extraction bay. Visual landmark: Split relay crown.
startScreen.howToPlay: WASD move · Mouse look · F restore console · Q fire · R reload · C crouch · Shift sprint · Esc pause. Activate Alpha, Beta and Gamma. The security gate opens after all three are powered.
startScreen.credits: Original models, textures and sound by Digital Opus. A pre-release engine example.
startScreen.controlsHint: Three relays to restore • F interact • C move quietly

ui.winMessage: The station is ready. Your route is complete.
ui.loseMessage: Return to the arrival point and choose a new route.
